cohort: The study included singleton and twin pregnant women from a tertiary-level hospital in Hubei Province, China, between 2011 and 2019.
finding: The secular trend of C-sections significantly increased among women with high socioeconomic status, and a previous C-section was associated with a higher likelihood of repeated C-sections in singleton women and GDM in the subsequent pregnancy of both singleton and twin women.
mod_finding: Previous C-section was a leading factor associated with a higher risk of C-section among singleton pregnancies and increased the odds of repeated C-sections in the subsequent pregnancy of singleton women.
